title: Nicki Minaj 02
name: nicki-minaj-02
arc:
A continuation of the arms-up Nicki groove. Weight starts over the character-left foot with the arm out at shoulder height, the character-right foot lifts at frame 3, then the weight drifts through centre (frame 13) to the character-right foot (frame 15) and back.

Arms stay framed at shoulder height, elbows bent; the hips drive. Pingpong: frames 0 and 30 are grounded turnarounds.

frames.cue: Weight over the character-left foot, both feet down. character-left knee slightly bent, character-right knee slightly bent. on the balls of both feet, heels lifted. character-left arm at shoulder height, elbow slightly bent, out to the side. character-right arm low by the hip, elbow straight, out to the side. torso leans character-left. character-right hip raised. head forward.
